work_packages.title: 买卖合同纠纷 — 民事起诉状 adaptation design
work_packages.objective: Prepare a scoped future design for aligning the 买卖合同纠纷 civil complaint with the inspected official element set, preserving the existing narrative output until separately authorized.
proposed_ui_changes: Add only the fields required by the reviewed element set for 买卖合同纠纷.
Keep every new field optional unless the review establishes that it is required.
Do not pre-fill any value from an official example.
proposed_model_changes: Add model attributes for the reviewed 买卖合同纠纷 elements only.
Preserve the existing tri-state semantics for confirmed/unconfirmed facts.
proposed_presenter_changes: Map new wizard fields in build_case_model without changing existing mappings.
Keep preview and export driven by the same model instance.
proposed_docx_changes: Keep the current narrative layout until a reviewed structural decision is made.
If an element-based layout is later approved, add it as a separate reviewed path.
work_packages.calculation_effects: No calculation change is proposed in this plan; monetary gaps stay review-only.
fact_integrity_requirements: Never turn absent or unconfirmed input into an affirmative allegation.
Preserve UNKNOWN / CONFIRMED_TRUE / CONFIRMED_FALSE for every tri-state fact.
Never import an official example value as a default.
regression_test_requirements: Extend document E2E tests for the new optional fields.
Extend factual-confirmation tests for any new tri-state fact.
Extend navigation tests for any new wizard field.
rollback_requirements: The change must be disableable without losing user inputs.
The legacy document path must remain available until release approval.
No rollback may invalidate source or approval audit evidence.
